app.name: TaskPilot
app.tagline: Personalized AI workflows without writing prompts.

hero.headline: Your recurring AI work, done for you.
hero.supporting: Answer a few questions, pick a schedule, and TaskPilot runs personalized assistants in the background.

problem.title: Stop repeating the same AI tasks
problem.supporting: People rewrite the same prompts every day—lessons, news digests, searches, prep. Context gets lost. Effort repeats.

how.title: Four steps. Nothing else.
how.supporting: Every workflow follows the same simple process. Complexity stays behind the scenes.

steps.title: Select a category
steps.description: Choose what you want automated—learning, newsletters, and more.

steps.title: Answer a few questions
steps.description: A short questionnaire replaces prompt engineering entirely.

steps.title: Choose when it runs
steps.description: Hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or on demand.

steps.title: Activate
steps.description: TaskPilot generates prompts, executes, learns, and notifies you.

products.title: Two products. One memory.
products.supporting: Automations and chat share your profile and long-term context, so everything feels personal.

automations.title: AI Automations
automations.description: Recurring workflows that run on a schedule or trigger—lessons, digests, searches—without you opening a chat.

chat.title: AI Chat
chat.description: A ChatGPT-like space for questions, brainstorming, and help—with the model you prefer.

categories.title: Start with learning
categories.supporting: Phase one focuses on learning automations. More categories plug in without changing how you use the product.

items.title: Language learning
items.description: German, English, and more—matched to level, goals, and study time.

items.title: AI & tech newsletters
items.description: Topic-focused digests at the length and frequency you want.

items.title: Programming learning
items.description: Guided practice around the stack and weekly hours you set.

categories.coming: Next up: real estate search, travel, fitness, job search, and more.

memory.title: It remembers what matters
memory.supporting: TaskPilot stores useful preferences from chats and runs—weak grammar topics, favorite neighborhoods, preferred summary length—and uses them next time.

cta.title: Let TaskPilot work in the background
cta.supporting: Choose a category. Answer a few questions. Select a schedule. Then get back to your day.

footer.rights: AI automation for everyone—no prompt engineering required.

auth.signInSupporting: Sign in to manage automations, chat, and your personal memory.
